items.text: fixed: in the heads-up display's Sounds pane the Sound set, Texture and Morph to rows had collapsed to thin lines, so you could not see or tap their buttons. They show in full again and wrap to the pane's width.
changed: the Sounds tab has its own icon, two waves (a voice and its texture), instead of the heads-up display's screen icon.
fixed: the four round corner buttons around the grid (swap, lock and friends) could stretch into tall ovals when the stage grew taller than the grid. They now stay round and a fixed size.
changed: the heads-up pane "Lines and auto dice" is now "Lines and dice".

changed: while the pencil is on, the field cube and clear, the sound load bars, and the clock, view and heads-up buttons step out of the left rail, so the colour buttons get the whole column. They come back the moment you return to a hand.

fixed: with the pencil on, the colour buttons on the left rail were squeezed into thin stripes, because the rail now carries the touch hand, the hold hand and the pencil. While you edit, the hold hand steps aside (it means nothing there) and the rail's buttons are a little shorter, so the colours get their room back. Everything returns when you go back to a hand.

fixed: in the zoomed film view the ripples, rings and sparks of the play lines were drawn small and bunched at the top left, not on the notes that were sounding. They now sit on the cells, at the cell's size. This came in with the sharper zoomed grid in 0.5.55 and 0.5.56.

changed: the heads-up display's foot is now the same band as Current's panels: a tab with the icon of each pane (the open one shows its name; the row scrolls on a phone), then a pin, previous, next and a close. The floating round × is gone. Pin keeps the display up when you tap the bare background.

when you start the robot and nothing can be heard because the crossfader has the grid faded out, every colour is muted or soloed away, or the master volume is at zero, a note in the corner says which.
hold the cube (about half a second) while the grid is in front to cycle Grid space through Off, Wide, Room and Deep. A short tap still flips wall and floor.

in full screen, tap three times with two fingers to swap which layer is in front, grid or field. Two fingers twice still swaps the touch and hold hands, now after a short pause to see whether a third tap follows.

changed: the cube now sets how the layer in front is heard. With the grid in front, wall is left to right only (Grid space: Wide) and floor adds depth, so the higher rows sit deeper and wetter (Room). With the field in front it is the field's wall or floor as before. The cube is yellow for the grid and green for the field, matching the two layer buttons. The Grid space menu in Sounds still has Off and Deep, and the cube follows it.
